measured.direction: Across the narrow top, perpendicular to the curved tooth length on the top surface
measured.precision: Rough user measurement; 0.7 mm is a nominal target, not a metrology tolerance

surface_detail.placement: Across tooth tops, fading toward the roots; reduced strength on the flanks.
surface_detail.spacing_basis: Rough visual comparison with the supplied 0.5 mm caliper gap. Perspective, focus, and differing surface planes prevent precise calibration.
surface_detail.amplitude_basis: Appearance assumption only. The photograph does not measure groove depth.
surface_detail.geometry_effect: Shading normals only. The CAD, STEP, and OBJ vertex positions remain unchanged.

notes: Supplied values are product-listing dimensions, not independently measured values.
The user measured the narrow tooth top at its midpoint as roughly 0.7 mm, perpendicular to the curved tooth length. The crown width is fitted to that measurement.
Gear5 provides the additional side view. Tooth height, root width, and sweep remain estimates; this photograph does not supply independent numerical values for them.
The tooth flanks are an estimated curved loft, not a generated conjugate or manufacturing tooth profile.
Four front holes are represented as smooth blind holes with chamfered entries. Thread form and depth are not specified by the source.
Mesh and CAD coordinates are in millimeters. Scale by 0.001 when importing into a scene using meters.
This model represents the undamaged large gear. No defects or laser inspection experiment are included.
Machining marks require the rendering material in machining_marks.py; they are not embedded in the CAD or OBJ geometry.
Bump mapping approximates changes in local reflection directions. It does not reproduce groove silhouettes, geometric self-occlusion, or coherent wave effects.
